hypothesis: Can native learned text-admission policy integrated with persistent bounded native Yggdrasil StatePool store newly observed directed links, answer unfamiliar composite language relations under delay/interruption and retain old associations when one additional fact is learned, without LLM assistance?
reality_check: Only the admission classifier is learned; exact edge storage uses an existing tensor StatePool and multi-hop traversal is explicit fixed code. It is a component integration feasibility study, not genuine learned cognition, and full NCI-01 acceptance is always false.
development: Tiny native torch.nn.Linear classifier (3 observed lexical byte-gram features and bias) fit using 48 development sentences with no first-use heldout labels, 80 epochs SGD. Compare learned prediction with fixed direct-only traversal on the same state.
frozen_criteria: COMPONENT_INTEGRATION_NOT_LEARNED_COMPOSITION if original two-hop and four-hop accuracy >=.75; otherwise NCI01_COMPONENT_INTEGRATION_BELOW_FEASIBILITY_GATE. NCI01_FULL_ACCEPTANCE always FALSE because relational representations and reasoning rule are not learned.
equal_resource_baseline: Direct-only query reuses the exact same StatePool, trained lexical gate and 7 active/9 retained cell state. Multi-hop uses more lookup steps; report total upper bound and CPU tensor bytes.
portfolio: 45% native cognition integration/45% foundational independent mechanism science/10% optimization effort target; future switch to 60/30/10 contingent on both projects passing specific native-generalization/memory gates.
